purpose: Select the two missing D1 reserves, for stratum 1 (provider-clear / reproducible) and stratum 2 (wrapper / alias indirection), after scope-decision-01.json narrowed the probe to three strata.

search_frame.early_stop_condition: two admissible reserves covering strata 1 and 2

results.rejection_reason: Stripe is used heavily but only through subscriptions.update / retrieve / deleteDiscount. No subscription-CREATING operation exists, and D1 reaches only the creating ones. A useful negative example: a heavy integration with zero occurrences of the fact.

results.in_repo_negative_example: a third checkout.sessions.create at apps/web/src/features/licensing/mutations.ts:179 uses mode: "payment" — D1 does NOT reach it. A locator keying on the method name over-reports by one third in this repository.
results.resolution_construct: client obtained three different ways: createStripeClient() factory in packages/billing/src/lib/stripe.ts, getStripe() from the app's own billing service, and a type-only import from @rallly/billing

results.lockfile: web/pnpm-lock.yaml (none at root; mise and buf alongside)
results.d1_call_sites: 6+, including sessionParams passed as a variable to checkout.sessions.create three times
results.decision: admissible as a D1 case, NOT used
results.why_not_used: Its cost profile is historically-messy / reproduction-hostile — two SDK versions, no root lockfile, several toolchains — and stratum 4 already has both a primary and a reserve. Using it would have meant reassigning a stratum after seeing results.
results.note: The most valuable ground-truth specimen found in either survey, retained for the semantic-impact corpus (§5.2). Every subscription-creating site already carries the backward-compatible form billing_mode: { type: "classic" } — the exact remedy D1 prescribes — and the one call site without it is mode: "setup", which creates no subscription and is correctly outside D1. It therefore contains five true positives correctly remediated and one true negative that a naive method-name locator would flag, plus doc-comment decoys mentioning subscriptions.create.

results.stripe: declared as "catalog:" in package.json; resolved to 13.11.0 in pnpm-workspace.yaml
results.lockfile: pnpm-lock.yaml, pnpm@11.2.1 (deno.lock and devbox.lock also present)
results.resolution_construct: exported singleton in packages/api/src/router/stripe/shared.ts; one hop from the call site
results.note: The version is deterministic but not where a reader looks for it: package.json says "catalog:" and the number lives in pnpm-workspace.yaml. Recorded as a reproduction wrinkle, not a defect.

outcome.manifest_completeness: six case IDs now available for the narrowed three-stratum probe

cross_survey_observation.statement: Across the seven D1-bearing repositories inspected in both surveys, billing_mode is mentioned in exactly one — unkey, where it is set to classic at every affected site. The other six omit the field entirely at every subscription-creating call site.
cross_survey_observation.caveat: Six of the seven pin an apiVersion predating 2025-09-30.clover, so their exposure is latent rather than realised; formbricks pins 2026-02-25.clover and is already running under the new default. This is consumer-derived knowledge and stays out of D1, exactly like the apiVersion observation.
cross_survey_observation.status: observation from a convenience sample of selection work, not a measurement
